content.text: In a world where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad reign supreme, creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Bangladesh are often left in the dark, unable to collect [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/get-payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-working-today|COREMERCH guide to payment]]s for their digital products due to platform restrictions.  Take the case of a Zimbabwe-based digital artist who, despite their best efforts, was met with rejection by Stripe, rendering their online store useless.  This is not a story of victimhood; it's a testament to the power of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-workers-crypto-payment-webhooks|The Full]] sovereignty.  By building their own payment and delivery pipeline using NOWPayments and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-delivery-explained-digital-3|cloudflare]] Workers, they were able to break free from the shackles of platform dependency and collect payments in their preferred cryptocurrency, USDT, with fees as low as $0.10 per transaction.  This is the story of how you too can achieve infrastructure sovereignty and collect payments for your digital products without relying on Stripe or any other platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-nowpayments-digital-store-works-how-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers form the backbone of a decentralized payment and delivery pipeline that allows creators to collect payments in their preferred cryptocurrency and deliver their products directly to customers, eliminating the need for intermediaries like Stripe or PayPal.  This infrastructure is not a workaround; it's a base-layer solution that gives creators full control over their payment and delivery processes, ensuring that they receive their payments promptly and without any delays.  With NOWPayments' 300+ cryptocurrency support and Cloudflare Workers' serverless architecture, creators can scale their operations effortlessly, without worrying about transaction fees or payment processing delays.  In this guide, we'll show you exactly how to set up this infrastructure and start collecting payments for your digital products today.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To deploy the NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers infrastructure, you'll need a few basic tools and accounts.  First, you'll need a Cloudflare account, which you can sign up for free.  Next, you'll need a NOWPayments account, which also comes with a free plan.  Additionally, you'll need to have a digital product to sell, whether it's an ebook, a course, or a software product.  Finally, you'll need to have a means of delivering your product to customers, such as a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account.  With these basic tools and accounts in place, you're ready to deploy the NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers infrastructure and start collecting payments for your digital products.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a Cloudflare Worker that integrates with NOWPayments.  You'll also need to set up a Supabase database to store your orders and a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to deliver your products to customers.  With these components in place, you'll be able to process payments and deliver your products to customers seamlessly, without any delays or transaction fees.  In this section, we'll walk you through the step-by-step process of setting up your payment and delivery pipeline using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers.
USDT on Tron settles in under 60 seconds for less than $0.10 in network fees — no payout schedule, no minimum threshold.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction.  This involves deploying your Cloudflare Worker and integrating it with NOWPayments.  You'll also need to configure your payment gateway and set up your delivery pipeline.  With these tasks complete, you'll be able to process your first transaction and start collecting payments for your digital products.  In this section, we'll guide you through the process of going live and processing your first transaction using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is up and running, you'll need to scale your operations to meet the demands of your growing customer base.  To do this, you'll need to configure your Cloudflare Worker to handle increasing traffic and integrate it with NOWPayments to process more transactions.  You'll also need to optimize your delivery pipeline to ensure that your products are delivered to customers quickly and efficiently.  In this section, we'll show you how to scale your operations using NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers, so you can focus on growing your business and increasing your revenue.

To deploy the NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers infrastructure, follow these steps:  Create a Cloudflare account and sign up for a free plan.  Sign up for a NOWPayments account and get a free plan.  Create a digital product to sell, whether it's an ebook, a course, or a software product.  Set up a Supabase database to store your orders.  Configure your Cloudflare Worker to integrate with NOWPayments.  Set up your delivery pipeline using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2.  Deploy your Cloudflare Worker and integrate it with NOWPayments.  Configure your payment gateway and set up your delivery pipeline.  Optimize your delivery pipeline to ensure that your products are delivered to customers quickly and efficiently.
